common_names_val: Mosaic Plant, Mosaic Flower, False Loosestrife
growth_habit_val: Floating rosette-forming aquatic; produces diamond-shaped leaves in a circular mosaic pattern on the water surface
plant_size_val: Rosettes 10–30 cm diameter; stems can reach 30–60 cm below water
leaves_val: Small, diamond-shaped, arranged in a precise geometric mosaic pattern; red-green coloration
flowers_val: Small yellow flowers emerge above the water surface
root_system_val: Submerged roots anchored in substrate; also produces adventitious roots
sun_req_val: Full sun (high light required for mosaic pattern)
water_req_val: Fully aquatic; needs still or slow-moving water 15–60 cm deep
soil_type_val: Rich aquatic substrate or pond soil
can_pots_val: Yes, in submerged pots or container water gardens
fert_schedule_val: Root tabs or liquid fertilizer monthly during growing season
organic_fert_val: Aquatic plant root tabs, clay-based fertilizers
common_diseases_val: Algae overgrowth, leaf rot in poor water quality
disease_prev_val: Maintain clean water, adequate circulation, remove dead leaves promptly
prop_seeds_val: Seeds can be collected from flowers; sow on wet substrate
prop_cuttings_val: Stem cuttings root easily in water; division of rosettes
water_usage_val: Fully aquatic; provides shade reducing evaporation
biodiv_val: Provides shelter for fish fry and aquatic invertebrates; oxygenates water
